name: How can I prepare my home before a renovation begins?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home before a renovation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a renovation starts, it's helpful to clear the work area of personal items, furniture, and valuables. Consider establishing a temporary living space if major areas like your kitchen or bathroom will be out of commission. Discuss with us any specific utility access needs and establish communication protocols. Protecting adjacent areas with coverings is also beneficial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, establishing temporary living spaces if needed, discussing utility access, and protecting nearby areas.
